name: Kashiwagi Kazuma
source:
The protagonist's upperclassman.
For some reason he resembles [url=/c46473]Hayate[/url].
He lives in the same neighborhood as the protagonist and has known her since they were kids.
He's admired by all the girls at school for being the perfect triple threat with good looks, good smarts, and good reflexes.
He's also the student council president.
